subject: Admin activity log proofing, export format & redaction questions
messages:
From: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@greenlinehealth.com
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: admin activity log bundle for SIG/SOC2 evidence

Hi Ava —

Thanks for taking this. As part of our ongoing SIG review we need a defensible export of admin activity for our tenant (Greenline Health) covering the window 2026-05-01 to 2026-08-15. Our auditors have asked for the following: actor identity, action verb, target resource (resource id or path), timestamp, originating IP (if available), region/az, session id (or equivalent), and any related request ids / kv-cache operations where applicable.

Couple of asks up front:
- Can you confirm which event types are included in your admin activity ledger (e.g., role changes, API key operations, console logins, model/route config changes, rollback/rollout events)?
- What are our options for delivery (S3 signed URL w/ HMAC manifest, SFTP, or an attested bundle via a signed Drive folder)?
- We need to understand redaction options for PII (e.g., IP pseudonymization vs full removal) and whether you can provide field-level HMACs with a customer-provided salt.

Please let us know your recommended default schema for the manifest (CSV + md5/hmac per file is fine) and an estimated timeline for a sample bundle and the full export. Our auditor (cc'd) will need a short attestation that the export is complete and unchanged after delivery.

Best,
Lydia
Senior Compliance Manager
Greenline Health

Attachments: none
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: security@greenlinehealth.com, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity log bundle for SIG/SOC2 evidence

Hi Lydia —

Thanks — we can do this. Quick answers and a few clarifying Qs so we scope the deliverable properly:

1) What we log (high level):
   - Admin actions: role/grant changes, user invites/removals, API key create/delete/rotate, MFA enrollment, permission escalations.
   - Console events: UI-driven route/model config changes, canary/rollout actions, manual scale changes.
   - Backend operator actions: job restarts, infra changes, privileged ops.
   - Auth/session metadata: successful/failed console logins, API token usage (masked), source IP, region, session_id, request_id.
   - Model-serving ops: model pin/unpin, quantization profile changes, cache invalidation events (we include kv-cache op ids where present).

2) Delivery options (we recommend S3 signed URL + HMAC manifest for integrity):
   - Full export as gzipped CSV(s) with a top-level HMAC-signed manifest (we can HMAC with a key you provide or we can produce per-file SHA256 + separate HMAC-signed manifest).
   - For high-sensitivity customers we offer an encrypted tarball with customer KMS (requires Private deployment agreement).
   - Sampling: can provide a sampled subset (time-boxed or event-type sampling) within 48 hours; full export typically 7–10 business days depending on window size.

3) Redaction/pseudonymization options:
   - IP hashing (SHA256) with optional salt provided by you — one-way (no reversible mapping).
   - Replace usernames with stable pseudonym ids per-user for correlation, or redact entirely.
   - Field-level redaction policy document and a redaction log explaining which fields were redacted.

Proposed next steps:
- Confirm the tenant id(s) to export and whether you prefer IP hashing with your salt or full redaction.
- Confirm delivery method (we recommend S3 signed URL + hmac manifest).
- We will produce a sample manifest and a 24–48 hour sample bundle (small window) for your auditor to review.

I attached a short matrix that compares export modes and a small sample manifest format we typically send.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Product Security, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: export_options_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet) — describes modes; admin_activity_manifest_sample.csv (CSV) — 10-row sample
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Re: Request: admin activity log bundle for SIG/SOC2 evidence

Forwarding draft manifest + HMAC template — please see inline notes.

On Sat, Aug 29, 2026 at 11:03 AM Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> (quoted) Proposed next steps:
> - Confirm the tenant id(s) to export and whether you prefer IP hashing with your salt or full redaction.
> - Confirm delivery method (we recommend S3 signed URL + hmac manifest).
> - We will produce a sample manifest and a 24–48 hour sample bundle (small window) for your auditor to review.

Notes from ops:
- We will normalize all timestamps to UTC in the export and include original timezone offset where present.
- We will compute per-file SHA256 and include a top-level HMAC (HMAC-SHA256) over the manifest; the HMAC key can be customer-provided or we can supply a one-time ephemeral key delivered via the Secure Transfer process.
- Sampling: for very large windows we recommend a stratified sample by event type + time slice — we can produce that within 48 hours to unblock audits while full export runs.

Attachments included here: hmac_manifest_template.txt (manifest template), admin_activity_manifest_sample.csv (10 rows).

—Kim
Kimberly Park
Program Manager, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference
From: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@greenlinehealth.com, Peter Barnes <peter.barnes@verifysigs.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 14:09:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity log bundle for SIG/SOC2 evidence

Ava / Kim —

This looks good and aligned with what our auditor expects. We confirm:
- Tenant id: greenline-prod-001 (please scope to that tenant only).
- IP handling: we request IP hashing with our salt (I will send the salt over a separate secure channel).
- Timestamp normalization: please normalize to UTC and include original offset column.
- Delivery: S3 signed URL + HMAC manifest (please provide the HMAC key exchange instructions).
- Sampling: please produce a 48-hour stratified sample first. If sample is acceptable, proceed with full export for the full window.
- Attestation: please include a short signed attestation (PDF) with the manifest declaring export completeness and methods used for redaction/hashing.

Can you provide the sample bundle by EOD Thursday (2026-09-02) and an ETA for the full export if approved? Also include a checksum and the manifest template in the package.

Thanks,
Lydia

—
Greenline Health Security Team (auditor cc'd)
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity log bundle for SIG/SOC2 evidence — confirmed next steps

Thanks Lydia — confirmed. Summary and timeline:

1) Scope: tenant greenline-prod-001; window 2026-05-01 -> 2026-08-15.
2) Redaction: IP hashing with salt you will provide (we will salt+sha256 the ip field); usernames will be pseudonymized with stable ids.
3) Timestamps: normalized to UTC with original_offset column.
4) Delivery: 48-hour stratified sample by Thursday EOD (2026-09-02). Sample will be a zipped CSV (admin_activity_sample_20260829.zip) plus manifest (admin_activity_manifest_sample.csv) and a small attestation (sample_attestation.pdf).
5) Full export: ETA 8 business days from sample approval (depends on dataset size). Will include per-file SHA256 and top-level HMAC-SHA256 over manifest.
6) Integrity & key exchange: we will provide instructions for uploading your HMAC key into our secure transfer vault (short-lived) or you can supply an ephemeral key via your KMS; we will not persist the key.

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d-export-samples (sample manifest + templates).

I will follow up once ops confirms the sample run has started — expected status update in 24 hours.

Best,
Ava
Product Security, Redwood Inference

Attachments: admin_activity_manifest_sample.csv, hmac_manifest_template.txt
